title: rosa × dumetorum f. semiglabra
intro: Rosa × dumetorum f. semiglabra, commonly known as the wild rose, is a deciduous shrub that belongs to the family Rosaceae. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to aid in digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa × dumetorum f. semiglabra include its use as a diuretic, astringent, and anti-inflammatory agent, which can help in treating various conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
